title: Nintendo Switch 2 quarterly sales fall 41%; earnings miss
summary: Nintendo said Switch 2 unit sales fell 41% from a year earlier to 2.67 million in the fiscal second quarter ended Sept. 30, while revenue of ¥448.2 billion and net profit of ¥73.5 billion both missed market expectations. The company kept its full-year target of 16.5 million units for the fiscal year ending March 2027.
